producer_report.summary: The firstmate page now uses 'judge' for firstmate's deciding part and 'worker' for task-running agents. A new test fails if the rendered real study contains 'agent' at all. `cargo test --locked`, clippy and fmt were clean when I last ran them. The earlier fixes (captain/yolo/home, t10, ra1-ra6 titles, reopened state, study id) are redone and the changelog is updated. Two kinds of 'agent' remain, both listed under criterion 2 below: the stored data value 'agent' and one verbatim source quote.

checks_run.note: Exit was clean. I could not read the full output because the shell blocks `tail` and the saved log is outside the working directory.

criteria_check.criterion: The glossary defines two distinct terms, one for firstmate's deciding part and one for the task-running workers, and the page says which term 'decided by' refers to.
criteria_check.evidence: The glossary defines 'judge' and 'worker'. site.rs maps the stored value 'agent' to 'judge' in the 'decided by' label.

criteria_check.criterion: Every use of 'agent' in model.json cards (triggers, failure, changes text such as t8 'no agent is running' and 'the running agent is replaced'), in rationales.json, findings.json and intro.json is replaced with the matching term, or is unambiguous and listed with a reason in the job notes.
criteria_check.evidence: I searched 'agent' (case-insensitive) in studies/firstmate-work-handling/*.json, excluding claims.json. There are three kinds of hit. (1) model.json lines 18, 20, 37, 39, 44, 52, 67, 78-80, 90, 97, 99 and 104 are the data-model enum values trigger_evaluated_by, guard_evaluated_by and actor set to "agent". They are never shown; site.rs renders them as 'judge'. The tests use the same value in fixtures. (2) rationales.json line 13 is a verbatim authors_say quote and line 15 is the same text as a source quote ('a later agent turn'). It must match the source file, so I left it. (3) rationales.json line 48 is the file path AGENTS.md. Prose such as t8 'no agent is running' now reads 'no worker is running', and the visible-text test shows none of the prose or the quote survives on the page.

criteria_check.criterion: The text generated by xtask/src/site.rs (evaluated-by labels such as 'decided by ...') uses the new term and no longer prints 'decided by agent' or 'checked by agent'.
criteria_check.evidence: site.rs lines 544-553 map 'agent' to 'judge' and 'the judge'. The test the_real_study_uses_judge_and_worker_and_never_the_ambiguous_agent asserts the rendered page has no 'decided by agent' or 'checked by agent'. A second test, at lines 897-902 of site.rs, checks the same for a fixture that stores 'agent'.

criteria_check.criterion: The job includes the output of a search for 'agent' across studies/firstmate-work-handling/*.json (except claims.json) and xtask/src/site.rs, with each remaining hit justified.
criteria_check.evidence: The search output is summarized in the previous row. The site.rs hits are the mapping function and doc comment (lines 544-553) and the test fixtures and assertions (lines 644, 673, 790, 824-828 and 897-902).

open_issues: The rationale quote 'not a later agent turn' (rationales.json line 13) and the same text in its source quote (line 15) are verbatim from a source file. The visible-text test may rely on that quote not being rendered; I did not confirm this.
mistakes: My first report listed the remaining 'agent' hits only vaguely. They are listed in full under criterion 2 above.
In this pass I re-ran the three checks and the 'agent' search but did not re-read the intro, t10, ra1-ra6 or reopened-state text, so those rows rest on my earlier edits.
learnings: The data model keeps evaluated_by = 'agent'. Only the renderer renames it, so fixtures and claims stay valid.
rationales.json holds source quotes that must match the cited files, so the word 'agent' can legitimately appear inside them.
